title: Tessryn G03 evidence contract v1
description: Registrations declare assumptions; fixture runs establish tooling implementation behavior only. The stdlib validator additionally checks canonical registration/evaluator/artifact bindings, timestamps, count accounting, percentile ordering, combined log limits, preregistered load/thermal/sample gates and numerical gate outcomes. Schema validation cannot establish the truth of claims or trusted evaluator independence. Latency sample_count counts completed request summaries; inter_token_ms uses one declared per-request summary. Throughput and goodput use completed requests per second. A native measured-performance pass requires available kernel boot; a device-artifact measured-performance pass additionally requires available GPU execution. Failed records can retain unavailable capabilities. Measured records require retained performance-trace, statistical, numerical and held-out report artifacts; the CLI additionally verifies their bytes, payload contracts and summary bindings. All measured formats describe inference workloads and passing records require available inference. Thermal duration cannot exceed observed duration; passing thermal identity matches preregistration. Rates equal completed/SLO-compliant counts divided by observation duration (relative tolerance 1e-9, absolute tolerance 1e-12 requests/s). A probed emulator is required for passing test fixtures; native records may identify a runner with emulator null, while all passing records require a nonnegative observed exit code.
